starting-off.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
starting-off.text: What ho, [sirrah/milady]. Jolly good show on the old training grounds thingy, what?

options.text: Do you have any jobs for me yet?

steps.player: Do you have any jobs for me yet?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well old [boy/gal/bean], looking at the old dossier we have on you here there seems to be a tiny problem, what?

steps.player: Problem? What problem? Er...  and you have a dossier on me???

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well OF COURSE we have a dossier on you! We have a dossier on EVERYONE! It's our job, dontchaknow!

steps.player: Um... okay... So what's the problem?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well now, seems we made a tiny blunder when we first contacted you to join the Temple Knights, what?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Entirely our own fault, could have been avoided and all that, but bit of a show-stopper, what?

steps.player: What is?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well old [boy/gal/bean], here's the thing; Only members of the White Knights may join the Temple Knights. By ancient decree, dontchaknow.

steps.player: What? But I am a member of the White Knights! I went and did that stuff with the cabbage and the potion!
And I've already done your stupid little mind test thing! You can't get rid of me that easily!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Calm yourself down old [boy/gal/bean]... We have no intention of 'getting rid of you', we are very keen on seeing you join us...

steps.player: Then what's the problem?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well, it's like this: Although you have performed a mission on behalf of the White Knights, you were never actually working for them.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: As I say, when our order was founded, we were expected to take the best of the best, and it was assumed that anyone worth having on the team would have been a White Knight already, what?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Sadly, this is not the case anymore, and the fact that you have to serve as a Squire to a White Knight for a minimum period of five years before you can actually become one tends to put the more short-attention

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: spanned adventurers off joining, what?

steps.player: You want me to be a squire for five years?!?!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Haw Haw Haw! No, no, goodness me, no!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Five years is a very long period of time nowadays - ANYTHING could happen in that time, and we need capable heroes like yourself as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: No, I had a bit of a chat with Sir Vey, and we came up with... A different solution to the problem. Assuming you're still interested of course.

steps.player: I'm still up for joining the Temple Knights, I just don't really feel like spending five years running around shining peoples boots for them.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Haw Haw Haw!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: I quite understand, what? No, don't worry, we were doing a little research into the White Knight Charter, and found an interesting loophole, what?

steps.player: Loophole? What kind of loophole?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well, you don't need to worry about the details, you just do as I tell you and it will all work out for us both, what?

steps.player: I guess... I don't really like blindly following orders though...
No, to be honest I'm getting sick of all these excuses and procrastination. Plus being an inititiate was nowhere near as fun as I thought it would be.
I'd rather just go off by myself and kill stuff for cash.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well, sorry to hear you say that old [boy/gal/bean], but I can't hold it against you.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: You will of course still be entitled to all that we can provide you with at an initiate level, but sadly you will never advance beyond that in our order. Was there anything you wanted?

steps.player: So what exactly do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well now, it's really very simple. I want you to go to Sir Amik, tell him that you have decided to not join the Temple Knights, and that you have decided to become a White Knight instead.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: He will then offer you to join as a squire; You will then decline his offer, and ask if you can be deputised instead.

steps.player: Okaaaay....

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: If you run into any problems with that, come and see me.

steps.player: I don't exactly understand how that will help me become a White Knight...

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Ah, your curiosity does you credit old [boy/gal/bean]! Let me tell you a little history lesson;

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Many centuries ago, the founders of the White Knights realised that in times of crisis, a long waiting period for new Knights could be disastrous for the kingdom, so they added a clause to the founding charter that would

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: allow any citizen who has performed an act in the name of the White Knights to become deputised on a purely temporary basis to a full-fledged White Knight.

steps.player: So how does that affect me?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well now, your actions in the Black Knights' Fortress on behalf of the White Knights make you eligible to be deputised.

steps.player: But if that's only temporary, and I have to be a 'proper' White Knight to then become a Temple Knight, doesn't that mean that I am still going to have to squire for Amik for five years?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Ah, well this is where the beauty of the plan lies, dontchaknow?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Once you have been deputised, for the time that you are still working for their order, you are subject to all of the same rules and regulations that normal White Knights are, which means you are also eligible for

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: battlefield promotions.

steps.player: I... don't understand...

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Let me put it like this; As a deputy you will be considered the lowest possible rank of White Knight, and may be removed entirely from their order at a whim.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: However, should you achieve some great feat while serving as a White Knight that you would be eligible for a promotion from, then by their own rules you would then have to be raised to a higher level within their

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: order, and it would therefore become impossible to remove your rank, or make you no longer a deputy.

steps.player: So I get to be a White Knight without having to do five years of pointless busywork?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Indeed. We Temple Knights have our reputation for a reason, dontchaknow?

steps.player: Okay, I guess that makes sense... But we're not in a time of crisis, so doesn't that mean I won't actually get deputised?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Ah, do not concern yourself with THAT old [boy/gal/bean]; Crisis is such a subjective term, and as you will find out when you join us fully in the Temple Knights, there is always some potential crisis or other brewing.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: If we weren't as good at our jobs as we were, almost every day would be a day of crisis!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: All we really need to do is allow the old White Knights to handle a problem that we would normally deal with, and that should be a sufficient crisis to allow you to be deputised, dontchaknow.

options.text: Do I really have to quit the Temple Knights?

steps.player: But... Do I really need to quit the Temple Knights?
You seem pretty cool, and I really like the armour...

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Haw Haw Haw!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: No, not at all, this is merely a ruse; Sir Amik knows full well that his authority over our organisation is limited, so he will not deputise you unless he thinks that you are entirely unaffiliated with us.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: You are simply going to tell him that you have decided not to join us so that he will in turn deputise you to join the White Knights! We of course still want you to join us, it is just a

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: little... misdirection.

options.text: What am I supposed to be doing again?

steps.player: What am I supposed to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: You are to go to Sir Amik Varze, leader of the White Knights of Falador, and are to tell him that you have decided not to join the Temple Knights.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: We will send him a messenger confirming this. He will offer you the opportunity to become his squire, you are to decline, and ask if you can be deputised instead.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: If you run into any problems with that, you are then to come and see me for further advice.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Understood?

steps.player: Um, yeah, I think so...

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: If the player has not asked Tiffy about his plan:

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well, I did have something you may have been interested in, but I've been given orders not to approach you for trivial matters now that you are a member of the Temple Knights.

steps.player: Aaaaawwwww...

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.player: Got any jobs for me to do today?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: Well, I did have something you may have been interested in, but I've been given orders not to-

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.player: Can I just stop you right there?

I am no longer a member of the Temple Knights, I have entirely renounced my application because after many hours of soul searching I have come to the conclusion that I desperately want to become a White

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: If the player is wearing Initiate Armour:

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: You don't want to be a Temple Knight anymore?

steps.player: That is correct, yes.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: But you are wearing their armour!

steps.player: So? Did you hear me bad mouth the armour? The armour is cool, I keep the armour!

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: I'm not sure I understand... You wish to desert the Temple Knights in favour of my own humble White Knights?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.player: And this is definitely not some kind of elaborate hoax to get my application processed faster.

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: I'm sorry, did you say something just then?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.player: No... Not if you didn't hear it...

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: ... Well anyway, for the fine work you achieved at that incident in the Black Knights Fortress, I would be honoured to accept you as my Squire.

options.text: What does being a Squire entail?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.player: So what exactly does being a squire consist of, then?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: You will spend the next five years of your life running various errands for me.

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: If I consider you to have done a more than adequate job of this, then I will begin to consider possibly moving your name forwards to becoming a full-fledged member of the Order of the White Knights.

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.player: So... No killing stuff for you, or anything fun like that...?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: Not as such, no. Unless you consider killing time by running errands fun...?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik.text: So what say you [player name]? Spend five long years of your life doing pointless busywork without pay for me, on the off chance that at some point in the future I may put your name forward

steps.player: Yes please! I would LOVE to be your squire!
Wait... Didn't Sir Tiffy tell me to decline...?
Nah, Squire me up, Amik!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: As you wish, from this day forth you are my Squire!

steps.player: Um... As tempting an offer as that sounds Sir Amik, I am really not a fan of waiting around...

Now, I heard from some completely random stranger that was definitely not Sir Tiffy Cashien as part of an elaborate ruse to fast track my application into the White Knights, that I could be deputised directly as a
White Knight, and entirely bypass that whole boring waiting for five years thing...

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: That is entirely correct [player name], but I have no idea where you may have heard that, for it is a secret guarded only to members of our order!

steps.player: Right. Well anyway, can I do that instead?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well, a fine adventurer such as yourself would be a perfect candidate as a deputy in my eyes, but fortunately this can only be done in a time of crisis, and all is currently well.

steps.player: All is well, huh? I'll be right back, I just have to go and ask...
nobody in particular if they can organise... nothing at all to happen.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: You are a strange one [player name]...

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.player: Got any jobs for me to do today?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.text: Only to become my Squire. Do you wish to become my squire?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.player: No, not really. So there isn't a crisis yet?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.text: Thank Saradomin, no! We have not had a crisis for many years now!

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.player: Right. Well, I'll go and see if Tiffy can fix that for me then.
Er, I mean: How fortunate for us all that nothing terrible has happened or is conveniently about to happen.
So do you have any squiring for me today Amik?

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.text: Yes, yes in fact I do. I would like you to bring me an Asgarnian Ale.

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.text: No matured Ale, no other brand, simply an Asgarnian Ale.

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-t.text: That is 'Sir Amik' or 'My Liege' – not 'Boss'.

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-r.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-r.text: Call me Sir Amik, or liege.

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-r.player: Sure thing, boss. I brought you a beer.

falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-r.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-first-visit-to-sir-amik-r.text: Well, another Asgarnian Ale would be greatly appreciated. And stop calling me Boss.

falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.player: I did it Tiffy! I became Sir Amik's squire!
That means in just five short years I can be a White Knight!
Yeeeesssssss.... But I thought it would be more fun to do this?

falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.text: sigh* This is a less than illustrious start to your career with us [player name].

falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.text: Never mind, all is not lost, I have sent word to Amik that a dangerous criminal we once thought exiled is on the loose again, and that he should send all available White Knights to confront him.

falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.text: This should give him enough of a scare to deputise you immediately.

falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
falador-park-the-crisis-talking-to-sir-t.text: Go and speak to Amik again, and then immediately come back here, we will need to prepare you for your mission.

steps.player: Hello again Tiffy. I've just spoken to Amik, and he says he's fine for me to be deputised as a White Knight, there just needs to be a crisis first.
I assume you can arrange a small crisis for me?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Haw Haw Haw, fitting right in with the Temple Knight way of thinking, what?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well, as a matter of fact, I will not have to organise anything, there is a particularly vicious and dangerous criminal currently at loose!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: I have already notified Sir Amik through the usual channels, so just go and speak to him quickly, then pop back here and we'll get you equipped for the hunt, what?

steps.player: You know... Is all this back and forth strictly necessary?
I don't mean to sound ungrateful for the help you're giving me here, but you could have just got this sorted out before sending me off there in the first place!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Ah, yes, well most awfully sorry about all the running around you've been doing old bean, but when it comes to our line of work, sometimes the indirect route is the best, what?

steps.player: I don't understand...?
And stop calling me bean! I am not a vegetable, I am a human bean, er, being!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Awfully sorry dear heart, it's just a term of affection, what? Anyway...

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: This criminal is a very dangerous fellow, and has some very dangerous friends.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: If he has no reason to suspect you to be working for us, then he will be a little sloppier than he otherwise might be, because he will just assume you to be one of those stupid White Knights.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: We want this man caught, for the good of the country, and if we need to fool a few people into thinking you're nothing to do with us, and you have to do a little extra walking, then that's what is going to happen, what?

steps.player: I guess... But this spy stuff is a lot more boring than it sounded at first...
Hi Tiffy. What am I supposed to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Go and report to Sir Amik for 'orders'. You will be unsurprised to find out he will now be prepared to deputise you.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: After you have spoken to him return here immediately, your life will be at risk without our assistance, and we don't want you dying on your first mission for us, what?

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.text: Thank Saradomin you have come back here!

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.text: We have received word from one of our scouts that the evil Solus Dellagar has returned to Asgarnia!

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.text: What is worse, it seems he is in possession of dangerous new magics that we are powerless against!

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.text: Please, I implore you in the name of all that is holy, assist us in banishing him from our kingdom once more!

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik.text: I cannot bear to think of the troubles he may bring us...

steps.player: Solus Dellagar? Who - or what - is that?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: You have not heard of the infamous murder-mage? He terrorised these lands many years past, thinking himself above the law with his powerful enchantments, but the White Knights finally managed to bring him to

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: justice and he was permanently exiled.

steps.player: Exiled? Why didn't you just kill him? Or, you know, imprison him or whatever?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Kill an unarmed foe? That is not the way of Saradomin, nor of the White Knights.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: As for imprisonment... Solus is a highly dangerous man not just because of his mastery of the magical arts, but for his uncanny resourcefulness.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: To tell you the truth, I fear that I would be unable to guarantee his captivity in any holding cell belonging to us...

steps.player: So if you can't imprison him, and exile obviously didn't work, you want me to kill him?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: I did not say that. I did not say that at all. That is against all of our codes of honour.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: However, should you find yourself in combat with him, and there is no other way, then perhaps for him to die would be best for us all.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: You understand me, [player name]?

steps.player: Oh yes. You've made yourself very clear.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: So will you aid us in this fight?

options.text: What will I get for helping?

steps.player: So what will I get if I help you out against this, er, solus doolalala guy then?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Why, you will help keep Asgarnia free of malicious influence, and perform a good deed in the name of King Vallance and of the White Knights!

steps.player: Yes, yes I see. So... No monetary compensation or other actual reward then?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: As Saradomin has told us, 'a good deed is its own reward'.

steps.player: So I don't actually get anything out of this then?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Nothing tangible, no, but you will be deputized to act as a White Knight, and you will feel a warm glow inside of having done the right thing.

steps.player: But you can't buy things with a warm glow...

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: So what say you [player name]? Fight with honour in the name of the White Knights against the terrible Solus?

steps.player: Hey, there's nothing I like more than fighting! Deputise me up, and I'll go get this guy for you!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Very well then; In the name of King Valence, and for the honour of Saradomin, I now pronounce you a fully deputised White Knight.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: May honour and glory follow you in every action.

steps.player: So where should I start looking for this Solus guy anyway?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: I haven't the faintest idea. Good luck!

options.text: I don't feel like helping you right now.

steps.player: A scary mage huh? Sounds like I could get KILLED!
Forget that, and forget you! No way am I risking my neck unless there's a big fat reward on the table for it!
And sometimes not even then...

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: It is a tragedy to hear you speak so, but we must trust in our valour and the wisdom of Saradomin to protect us from this evil man if we cannot enlist help against him.

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik-.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik-.text: [player name]... Solus Dellagar is still loose... Please, for the safety of my lands you must find him immediately...

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik-.player: Any hints on where he might be?

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik-.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik-.text: We have no idea where he might be now... His magic is too powerful for us, I do not know how to stop him...

falador-castle-second-visit-to-sir-amik-.player: Hum. I wonder if Sir Tiffy might be able to help?

steps.player: Tiffy, it worked exactly to plan! Sir Amik deputised me to take care of this Solus Doolally dude, so let's go get him!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: His name is Solus Dellagar, and honestly, he is one of the most dangerous men in Gielinor.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Not only is he extremely adept at magic, he is also quite prepared to use that magic at a moments notice, because he is quite, quite mad.

steps.player: So... Dragonhide armour and an elemental shield and I'm laughing?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: No, no, no. Listen to me [boy/girl/kid]; You are under NO CIRCUMSTANCES to engage him directly in combat!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: You are to act as our agent and track him down, when you have managed to corner him somewhere then we will send in a field recovery team directly to take him away without incident.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: I cannot stress this enough; You are to observe and locate, you are NOT to enter a combat situation!

steps.player: Riiiiight... So I'm just going to scout him out for you then.
Any tips on how to find him?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well old bean, we will need to equip you for the task, but you'll need to get something for me first, what?

steps.player: What kind of stuff?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well, we teach our operatives the value of their equipment by making them pay for it, what?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: You have two choices here, you can either give me cash directly, and I will hand it over, or you can bring me the raw materials and I will make you one.

steps.prompt: What would you like to do?

steps.text: If the player does not have enough inventory space:

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Well we in the Temple Knights have some specific equipment for situations such as this dontchaknow, but you'll need to free up some inventory space first!
If the player has enough inventory space and enough money:

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: It's 10,000 coins for the Temple Knight Communication Orb. You have that kind of money with you?

steps.player: Oh yeah, I got your money.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Then you wish to purchase a Temple Knight Communication Orb?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Here, take this Communications Orb, or 'CommOrb' for short.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: It is a precise magical mechanism that we can use to track him, by sending data of the surrounding area back to one of our information operatives at the Temple Knight headquarters.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Your information operative is known as Savant, I suggest you contact them using your CommOrb at your earliest convenience.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: They will be able to send you any useful data about Solus directly through it for your perusal, dontchaknow.

steps.player: Okay, thanks Tiffy!
I don't have that kind of money with me...

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Perhaps you would like to just bring me the components of it then, what?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Bring me one Law Rune, one Slayer Gem and one piece of Molten Glass and I will make you a Communication Orb.
If the player has one of the items needed:

steps.player: Can I give you the components I have with me now?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Heavens, kid! I am not a pawn shop, to be holding bits and pieces for you while you go off and do something else!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: No, no you bring me all three components at the same time, what?

steps.player: Okay Tiffy.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have the materials:

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Bring me one Law Rune, one Slayer Gem and one piece of Molten Glass and I will make you a Communication Orb.
If the player has one of the items needed:

steps.player: Can I give you the components I have with me now?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Heavens, boy! I am not a pawn shop, to be holding bits and pieces for you while you go off and do something else!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: No, no you bring me all three components at the same time, what?
If the player has all the materials:

steps.player: I have all three components for you to make me a Communication Orb out of now Tiffy.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Excellent! You wish me to make you one now then, what?

falador-park-mission-details-talking-to-.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
falador-park-mission-details-talking-to-.text: It's 10,000 coins for the Temple Knight Communication Orb. You have that kind of money with you?

steps.player: Hi Tiffy. What am I supposed to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: You are hunting for Solus Dellagar, the evil criminal mastermind.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: I suggest you contact Savant through your CommOrb and see if she can send you any relevant information about your assignment.

steps.player: Hey Tiffy, I lost my CommOrb...

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Very careless of you, what? Here, take another, but be careful of this one!

falador-park-mission-details-contacting-.speaker: Savant
falador-park-mission-details-contacting-.text: Well, hello! You must be [player name]? Sir Tiffy told me to expect you to call in on this frequency!

falador-park-mission-details-contacting-.speaker: Savant
falador-park-mission-details-contacting-.text: So what do you think? Pretty nifty little piece of kit this crystal, huh?

falador-park-mission-details-contacting-.player: Yeah, it must be very useful.

falador-park-mission-details-contacting-.speaker: Savant
falador-park-mission-details-contacting-.text: Oh, trust me you'll find out exactly how useful! Now, was there something you wanted?

falador-park-mission-details-contacting-.prompt: What would you like to ask about?

steps.player: Hi Savant! I was wondering if you could give me details on my current assignment?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Okaaaaay... Bringing up your current assignment details...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Oh! You're chasing Solus Dellagar?

steps.player: Oh yeah! So any information you can give me?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Listen [player name]. Solus is an incredibly dangerous criminal, and I don't think his grasp on reality is too tight, if you understand what I'm saying.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: You really need to take care with this one. I'm amazed you got an assignment as tough as this one as a first assignment to be honest!

steps.player: So, how would you suggest I go about finding him?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well, this CommOrb can use the scan function to find him, but its range is very limited.

steps.player: So I have to just wander around the place looking for him?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: No, that would take far too long... Listen, I am going to transfer all information on Solus that we currently have to your CommOrb.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: You should be able to find a hint of where to find him by examining it.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The Library tells me that we have two visual recordings from SpyOrbs available to you, as well as a standard dossier.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I would suggest the people that the SpyOrbs were observing, when they picked up records of Solus, would be a good place to start your investigation.

steps.player: Who are these people then?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Okay, just checking now...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Record one is from a routine monitoring of Lord Daquarius.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: In case you haven't heard of him, he is the leader of the Kinshra, also known as the Black Knights.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: As a major enemy of the White Knights we have had him under observation for some time now, so it was pretty lucky that Solus decided to visit him.

steps.player: So where would I find this Lord Daquarius?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: He has a secret Black Knight training ground deep in the heart of Taverley dungeon, along with holding facilities for prisoners who they wish to interrogate later.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: He is almost certain to be found thereabouts.

steps.player: And what is Record 2 about?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Just checking... Ah yes.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: This shady fellow is a member of the Zamorakian Magical Institute.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: We suspect them to be the group responsible for destroying the Wizards Tower all of those years ago, as well as other more recent acts of sabotage.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: We also suspect that they have been responsible for a number of thefts of a mysterious rock that the Wizards Tower has started producing, but don't have much intelligence about that.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: We set up an observation SpyOrb in a known Zamorakian shrine in south-east Varrock, but he moves between there and the wilderness just north of Edgeville quite frequently.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: He doesn't seem much of a threat, but we placed him under observation anyway, which seems to have paid off by getting some more information about Solus.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: From the look of the record, he would be worth talking to as well.

steps.player: Thanks Savant!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Any time, [player name]. Over and out.

steps.player: So... Savant... That's an unusual name...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well, obviously it's not my real name!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: My real name is Elyssa Van Lendes, but for operational purposes I am called Savant.

steps.player: So what exactly do you do for the Temple Knights?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I am the S.M.R and Chief Librarian for the Temple Knights.

steps.player: S.M.R? What's that?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It stands for Senior Mystical Researcher. The Temple Knights have a world class research team investigating new types of magic constantly. As senior researcher, and field liaison, I can pass on

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: information to the rest of the Temple Knights.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Many of the devices used by the Temple Knights such as our CommOrbs and SpyOrbs were first designed by my team as experimental devices, and have since become standard field equipment!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I have always had a gift for magic, and have spent most of my life trying to find applications for it that would serve our order and give us an edge over our opponents.

steps.player: Your opponents?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Oh yes, don't think for a second that we are the only secret organisation in Gielinor!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: There are many factions in these lands, some almost as magically advanced and organised as ourselves!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It is a constant struggle to keep our operatives with advanced magical equipment that our opponents don't have - this is why we have the self-destruct safeguards, to prevent our equipment ever falling into unfriendly

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: hands.

steps.player: So how did you end up working for the Temple Knights?
I would have thought someone like you would have ended up researching at the Wizards' Tower or something instead...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Oh yes... The Wizards' Tower...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Let me tell you something, the mages who work there are idiots! They told me that magical research wasn't suitable for 'just a girl' and that I would be 'too scared' to research

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: for them effectively!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Luckily the Temple Knights are far more open minded about things, and I really feel like my work is making a difference to them!

steps.player: Ok, thanks Savant, that was very interesting.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Hey, we're all Temple Knights here, right? Glad I could help, [player name]

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Savant over and out.

steps.player: Hi Savant. I was just wondering if you could give me a little information about the Temple Knights?
I've just realised that I really don't know very much about them...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well, you are not yet officially a full fledged Temple Knight now, are you Initiate [player name]?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I am afraid that means for security reasons I can only give you a brief overview of the organisation...

steps.player: Well, that's better than nothing right?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: That is usually the case, yes, I agree. Well, let's see if I remember how this goes... 'Legends tell us that Lord Saradomin once walked these lands amongst us, and delivered his wisdom unto us

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: personally, so that we could grow wise in his honour.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: But then came the war, that shattered our lands, and the interloper banished our land from us!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: But the wisdom of Saradomin knew that such events might occur, and he laid plans in secret amongst his most devout followers!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Those warriors whose hearts were as pure as their minds were sharp were called to him, and were made into his Temple Knights, for they were the Knights that guarded his very first Temple.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: All who dwelled in his lands knew that the Temple Knights were the honoured, the blessed, the personally chosen warriors of Saradomin, and thus were they given great freedom and authority in all of our Lords

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: lands.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: But with Saradomin no longer with us, the Temple Knights were no longer honoured and respected by all!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Rather, they were made targets by Saradomins enemies, and driven from the lands unjustly!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Thus it was that they became a secret force, hidden from the eyes of Saradomins enemies, that could strike against evil in his name swiftly and quietly whenever they may be needed.'

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Something like that I think, it's been a long time since I heard it last...

steps.player: Okay, thanks Savant.
Nothing thanks Savant, I was just checking this thing still worked!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: You shouldn't really waste my time like this, [player name]...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Still no harm done, I guess! Call me if you need me!

steps.player: Okay Savant, will do.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Savant out.

steps.player: Hi Savant! Any ideas on how I should track down Solus?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Record 1 shows Lord Daquarius in his lair in Taverley Dungeon and Record 2 is some Zamorakian mage that runs a rune-smuggling business between the wilderness north of Edgeville and Varrock.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: They are the last known people to have seen Solus, so they must have some information about where he is hiding out!

steps.player: Okay, thanks Savant.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Solus approaches Lord Daquarius, who is guarded by two Black Knights.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Still festering in your pathetic little dungeon, I see.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I thought you dead many moons past...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: You know you are not welcome here.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Now is that any way to talk to a fellow Zamorakian?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: You are not a Zamorakian! You worship nothing but your own selfish greed.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Such mistrust of your forgotten ally!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Why did I ever leave these lands?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: You left because your own stupidity brought the wrath of the Temple Knights upon you.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Now I ask you a final time before I draw my blade:

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I just thought you would like to know that I have returned as your new master.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: The Kinshra are not your personal soldiers Solus!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I will not waste any of my warriors in your foolish schemes!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: And is that your final answer Daquarius?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Or there will be blood shed between us.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Have you forgotten just who I am?
Solus casts Ice Barrage, killing the two Black Knights next to Lord Daquarius, and leaving him barely alive.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I won't have to remind you of my power again next time!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Make sure you are more prepared to follow orders next time I come to your little Taverley hideout!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I swear... in the name of *cough* Zamorak... I will see you rot for this Solus...
Solus teleports to the Chaos altar in the middle of Varrock.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: A shrine to Zamorak in the middle of Varrock?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I assume my reputation precedes me!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I have no riches, I am but a magical researcher...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: My dear fellow, if I wanted you dead, you ALREADY WOULD BE!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I... I don't know w-what you want Solus, but whatever it is, please, just t-take it and leave, please...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Well I am particularly interested in your brains at the moment!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: But you wouldn't want me taking those and leaving, now would you?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I am interested in your research!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I c-cannot let you have my research, it is being done in order to assist my lord Zamorak...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: But he is not here, is he?
The Mage of Zamorak attempts to teleport away, but Solus stops him with a spell that teleblocks and binds him.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: You are going nowhere just yet sir

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I meant no disrespect Solus, please do not kill me...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: If I killed you then you would no longer continue with your most interesting research!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: No, I will be content with simply taking your money sir!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Well, a most productive trip on all accounts!

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!

lord-daquarius.player: I am here on behalf of the White Knights...

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: Pah! Begone, fool, or prepare to taste my blade!

lord-daquarius.player: Now wait a minute, this concerns a friend of yours...

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: A friend of mine? What friend of mine would the Temple Knights show any intere-

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: Oh. This... This is about Solus, isn't it?

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: Then let me assure you, that monster is no 'friend' of mine - if indeed such a creature even has 'friends'!

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: No, that man is certainly no friend of mine nor of the Kinshra.

lord-daquarius.player: So you will help me find him?

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: No fool... You and your White Knight cronies are no friend of the Kinshra either.

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: I will help neither of you, and I wish you all a slow and painful death.

lord-daquarius.player: You know... I'm sure I could MAKE you tell me where he is...

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: Is that a threat, whelp? Do your worst. I care not for my own life, I stand only for the protection of the Kinshra!

lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius.text: [player name]? I've been monitoring you. He's telling the truth, so don't try to bluff him by starting a fight.

lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius.text: All of our records show that the only thing he will make a stand for is the protection of his men, and he has little regard for his own safety in comparison.

lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius.text: You're going to have to find some other way to intimidate him into giving you the information we need.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: I still want to know the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Well you will not hear that from me, White Knight dog!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: And you can threaten me all you want, I care for nothing in this world save the welfare of my Kinshra brothers!

lord-daquarius-after-killing-a-black-kni.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-after-killing-a-black-kni.text: Stop! I will tell you what you want! Please... leave my men be...

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: Okay Daquarius, you tell me the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar right now, or I will put every Black Knight here to their death in front of you!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: sigh* I should have known the White Knights would be my ruin once again...

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: I do not know his exact whereabouts, and when last we met we did not leave... on the best of terms.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: All I know is that he left behind some fur when he left, I would expect him to be in an area with furred creatures of some sort.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: What kind of fur? Dog? Bear? Wolf?

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: I do not know, I am a warrior, not a zookeeper. It was not bear fur, I know that much.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: That's it? That's your help? You'd better not be lying Daquarius, or...

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Calm yourself [player name], he is telling the truth.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: I am monitoring your conversation through the CommOrb, his physiology shows none of the changes we usually get when someone lies to us.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: So this CommOrb thing can work as a lie-detector? That's pretty useful!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Yes, it is, but back to the task at hand. I suggest you head to the next subject of our observations, he might be more help in locating Solus.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: You mean that Zamorakian mage in Varrock?

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Yes, he would seem a likely bet. Savant out.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: Okay Daquarius, tell me all that you know of Solus, or I will kill some more Black Knights!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: I have already told you, I know nothing except that he left some fur behind.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Now leave me and my men be, or it will be the worse for you!

zamorakian-mage.prompt: What would you like to talk about?

steps.player: I am looking for information about a very dangerous man... I believe he visited you quite recently.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Ah, you mean that accursed Solus!

steps.player: Yes, him. I need to find him and make sure he doesn't come back to these lands.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: You are working for the Temple Knights, correct?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: No, don't deny it, I recognise the magical signature of your Communication Orb, a very nice piece of equipment indeed.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: I will tell you what I know in exchange for it, I believe such a device could be very useful to my research...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: [player name], I've been monitoring your conversation; You can't let him have Temple Knight equipment, he is a Zamorakian!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Even if we wanted to let the Z.M.I. have access to our research, the built in security magics would destroy it before trading anyway!

steps.player: Sorry, I cannot trade you my Communications Orb...

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Ah well, it was worth a try, but I did not seriously expect you to part with it.

steps.player: Then perhaps you will be willing to trade something else for your information...?

approaching-canifis.text: Many years ago the Temple Knights were studying teleportation techniques, and found a strange dimension that was accessed when teleporting..

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: From your perspective you can see three places simultaneously, and can choose to move between all three at will!

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: but invisible to anyone in either.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: You could also move freely between the two invisibly and then choose which place you wished to end up, simply by concentrating on the location you wanted to appear in.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant

approaching-canifis.text: pass through.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Frankly, the human mind isn't equipped to cope with processing so much information simultaneously, and the test subjects started to display... behavioural problems...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: No, it wasn't: Aggressiveness was highly increased, and there were numerous perceptual faults, hallucinations and the like.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: We ceased experimentation immediately, there are enough things in this world to haunt a Temple Knight, we did not see the need to create anymore.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant

scanning-the-fourth-location.player: It's the type of spear used by the Dorgeshuun goblins.

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: The who? I've never heard of them before...

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: Well, if you know who or what they are, you should go and see them, Solus must be nearby!

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: You should probably take a minute to restock on supplies and heal up though [player name].

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: I know we can find him and bring him to justice, but we don't want you dying while doing so!

scanning-the-fourth-location.player: Okay Savant, I'll heal up, then go looking for him amongst the Dorgeshuun.

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Woman
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Oh thank you, you have freed me!

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Woman
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Oh, I am but a poor maiden kidnapped by the evil Solus!

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Woman
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: But you chased him so hard, that now I am free...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: [player name], I am getting some strange readings from this 'maiden'...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Sorry [player name], I should have spotted his little trick earlier...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Are you okay? That looked like a nasty sucker punch...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Did anyone get the number of that wagon?

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Don't worry [player name], I am reconfiguring your CommOrb to compensate for any camouflage magics.

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Please tell me you have a reading on his actual location by now, this chasing him around the houses is becoming irritating...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: No, but every time he escapes you I am shutting down his teleport to a specific area.

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: I think we are on the final stretch now [player name]!

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: I will be able to shut his teleports down permanently in 2, perhaps 3, more scans...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Keep up the chase [player name]! We nearly have him cornered!

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Uh... Out of interest, what am I going to do with an insane super-powerful murderous mage when he's cornered?

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Leave that to me and the Temple Knights [player name].

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Just follow your orders and continue the chase, and his days are numbered.

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Well okay then, where should I head now?

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Let's see what we managed to snag in the scan this time!
(A random item is given to the player; see Scanning in Canifis section for full list)

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Okay, I'm on my way – and Solus had better watch out, I am up to here with his annoying tricks!

scanning-the-sixth-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-sixth-location.text: Well you ARE a persistent one, aren't you?

scanning-the-sixth-location.player: I am here to take you in, Solus. You can forget your little tricks.

scanning-the-sixth-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-sixth-location.text: Little tricks, you say? Well how about this one!

scanning-the-sixth-location.speaker: Solus
scanning-the-sixth-location.text: Say hello to my little friend! And goodbye to me!

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: Okay, we have our scan results...

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: It's some kind of highly magically susceptible rock...

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: Isn't that the same rock that you gave that Zamorakian mage in Varrock?

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.player: Yeah it is, which means I know where he is, and how to get there!
It's a mine for Rune Essence, but there are only supposed to be a few people who know how to get there...

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: Let's worry about that later; Go get Solus!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: Okay, I've blocked all exits from this place except for Temple Knight teleports...

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: I think we finally have him!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Solus Dellagar
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: Argh! I am so sick of your interference!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Solus Dellagar
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: I think it is time we end this once and for all!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.player: In the name of the White Knights of Falador, and of the Temple Knights of Saradomin, I am placing you under arrest!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: Savant teleports in Temple Knight rangers.
Solus casts Ice Barrage, killing all of the Temple Knight rangers.

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Solus Dellagar
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: You... You meddlesome... You meddlesome freak!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: [player name], Solus is very weakened, and we don't have any more men to spare!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: Take him out now! This might be your only chance!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-after-.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-after-.text: Now that Solus is defeated you should take his hat to Sir Amik to prove that you were responsible.

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-after-.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-after-.text: VERY well done, [player name]. Very well done indeed.

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-commun.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-commun.text: Hello there [player name]. What can I help you with?

steps.player: Hi Savant. Where am I supposed to be looking for Solus again?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: You're not looking for Solus [player name], you are supposed to be taking his hat to Sir Amik of the White Knights as proof that you have defeated him.
If the player lost the hat:

steps.player: But I lost his hat...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I have sent you a duplicate, try not to lose it.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Go and take it to Sir Amik so that he can make you a full-fledged White Knight!

steps.player: I did it Tiffy! I brought Solus in for capture!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Had a little help doing it though, didn't you, what?

steps.player: Yes... But I did all the legwork...

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Haw Haw Haw!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: That you did Initiate, that you did.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Now take that hat of Solus over to Sir Amik, and we can begin to process your application form as a Temple Knight again, what?

steps.player: Okay Tiffy, I'll be back in a jiffy!

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: You are supposed to be looking for Solus Dellagar!

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: The insane magician who is loose once more upon these lands? Remember?

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: You have??? Then you must have some proof of your encounter!

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: A weapon perhaps, or an item of clothing?
If the player lost the hat:

steps.player: Well of course I do! I mean I did... Look, I lost it okay? Stop hassling me!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Look, I am very sorry [player name], but if you have no proof of your encounter, I can hardly promote you to be a full White Knight, now can I?

steps.player: Oh man... I think I've messed up... Maybe Savant can help me out somehow? I'd better speak to her.

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: If the player has the hat in the bank:

steps.player: Well of course I do! I just happened to think it would be a good idea to leave it in the bank for safe keeping.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well bring it here so that I can authenticate your claim and make you a White Knight!

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: If the player has the hat:

steps.player: Well of course I do! I have it right here!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well hand it over then, and let's see it!
Congratulations! Quest complete!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Now that you are a White Knight I should perhaps explain a little about how our system works.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Sadly we are not as rich as we once were, and there are many White Knights who foolishly lose their combat equipment.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: We do not think it fair to make a profit from our brethren, so we will sell you equipment at cost, and rebuy it at the same cost, but we will only sell equipment to those we consider responsible enough to

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: wield it correctly.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: By killing Black Knights, you will increase your reputation with us, by killing White Knights we will obviously think less of you.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: You can check your White Knight reputation level by looking at your quest journal for the Wanted! Quest, or Sir Vyvin will let you know what level you are at when you go to purchase equipment.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Sir Vyvin can be found in Falador Castle, and he will sell you any equipment appropriate to your reputation level.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Have fun, and go kill some Black Knights for me!

steps.player: Okay Amik, thanks for explaining!

gqybR2.speaker: Savant
gqybR2.text: Our observation records are classified, you can't go viewing them in unsecure areas. I recommend you secure youself within the White Knights' Castle if you want to watch it.

QCvnBD.speaker: Savant
QCvnBD.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find bananas...
